question: Who among the following signed a Tripartite treaty on behalf of the British Government to interfere in the affairs of Afghanistan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Auckland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tripartite treaty:-**

 
 
• Lord Auckland signed the Tripartite treaty on behalf of the British Government to interfere in the affairs of Afghanistan.
 
• The treaty was signed in 1838 between the British, Afghan, and Sikh empires.
 
• The treaty was aimed at countering Russian influence in Afghanistan.
 
• The treaty ultimately led to the First Anglo-Afghan War, which ended in a British defeat and withdrawal from Afghanistan. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Mayo:-**

 
 
• He was the Viceroy of India from 1869 to 1872 and was assassinated in the Andaman Islands.
 
 
 
• **Lord Wellesley:-**
 
 
• He was the Governor-General of India from 1798 to 1805 and was known for his aggressive policies towards the French and other European powers in India.
 
 
 
• **Lord Canning:-**
 
 
• He was the Governor-General of India during the Indian Rebellion of 1857 and oversaw the transfer of power from the East India Company to the British Crown.
